|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Bodhi Rook]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; bracketed names such as [Episode VII] stand for icons printed on the cards, and ▲ is the card's icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Bodhi Rook]]): Virtual Set 6 release ([[Virtual Set 6]]); Players Committee card image<ref name="ht0">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/bodhirook.gif bodhirook.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 022435b "Set 9 load", 8 July 2018.</ref>. The pilot icon reads “2, 3: Rogue One or a stolen starship”: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3 if Rogue One or a stolen starship. May be deployed simultaneously with a piloted starship from hand to a system even without presence or Force icons. If about to be lost, your Rebel or Rebel starship at a related location may make a regular move.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bodhi Rook (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="ht1">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/bodhirook.gif bodhirook.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit eb9f1e8 "V6 Remaster Part 2", 22 April 2024.</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3 if Rogue One or a stolen starship. May be deployed simultaneously with a piloted starship from hand to a system even without presence or Force icons. If about to be lost, your Rebel or Rebel starship at a related location may make a regular move.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same; the card was remastered (new frame rendering, the image-credit line removed from the text box area). A version because the change is visible on the card (Bill, 12 November 2026). No errata mark. The card prints the errata mark “none” although this is change 1 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). Before/after: [[File:V6-L-Bodhi_Rook-compare-022435b-eb9f1e8.png|440px]]
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image, marked “E1”<ref name="ht2">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/bodhirook.gif bodhirook.gif] in the PC's Holotable image repository (the images served at res.starwarsccg.org), commit 9d2c01e "Fixing case and making gifs", 30 December 2024.</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3 if Rogue One or a stolen starship. Once per game, during battle, may peek at opponent's hand. If about to be lost, your Rebel or Rebel starship at a related location may make a regular move.” '''What changed:''' “May be deployed simultaneously with a piloted starship from hand to a system even without presence or Force icons.” became “Once per game, during battle, may peek at opponent's hand.” No errata sheet has been found; the PC card data changed on 13 January 2025. The card prints the errata mark “E1” although this is change 2 in release order: a PC transcription error in the mark (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text. Before/after: [[File:V6-L-Bodhi_Rook-compare-eb9f1e8-9d2c01e.png|440px]]
